name: storybook-studio
description: StoryBook Studio — AI storybook SaaS (MERN, JavaScript only)

scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client && npm run test:contract
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.dev:memdb: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:memdb --workspace server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.dev:stub: concurrently -n stub,server,client -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev:aistub --workspace server" "npm run dev:memdb:stub --workspace server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.dev:stub:api: concurrently -n stub,server -c magenta,blue "npm run dev:aistub --workspace server" "npm run dev:memdb:stub --workspace server"
